# Cryogenic results (generated by studies/cryogenic_report.py; do not edit)

Cryogenic proxy on the SKY130 FET models (|V_T| + dV_T, mobility × mu, all bins), run at 27 °C. Bands: 300 K: PDK models; 77 K proxy: dV_T = +0.1 V, mu × 1.7; 4 K proxy: dV_T = +0.15 V, mu × 2; 4 K high: dV_T = +0.2 V, mu × 2; 77 K Beall fit: nMOS dV_T = +0.1 V, mu × 2.5; pMOS dV_T = +0.8 V, mu × 3; 4 K, Beall pMOS: nMOS dV_T = +0.15 V, mu × 2; pMOS dV_T = +0.8 V, mu × 3. C_node = 1 pF. Reference point s = 10 dec/V, 99.9 %; worst case s = 33.69 dec/V, 99.99 %.
